projects.title: External Pipe Repair
projects.summary: Cast iron soil and rainwater stacks running the full height of a narrow lightwell, reached on rope for inspection and repair. Soil pipe repairs at this height can reduce the need for scaffolding where a lightwell leaves little room to erect it.

heroImage.alt: A rope access technician working on cast iron soil pipework high in a narrow lightwell

projects.title: Gutter & Downpipe Clearance
projects.summary: Gutters, hopper heads and downpipes cleared on a residential block — including an outlet blocked solid with leaf litter, and a downpipe with a plant growing out of it. Roofline drainage can be reached directly from above where the roof allows it.

heroImage.alt: A rope access technician working at the roofline of a brick residential block

projects.title: Brickwork Repointing
projects.summary: Weathered chimney stacks and parapet brickwork with eroded and missing mortar joints, rigged and worked from rope. Isolated high-level masonry often suits rope access, where scaffolding a whole elevation would be disproportionate to the repair.

heroImage.alt: A tall brick chimney stack rigged with ropes against a clear sky

projects.title: Lightning Protection Works
projects.summary: Conductor tape running the full height of a brick elevation, with saddle fixings set into the mortar joints, reached on rope from roof level down. BOVI provides the access; testing and certification sit with a specialist lightning protection engineer.

heroImage.alt: A rope access technician descending a red brick elevation above a street

projects.title: Mastic & Sealant Renewal
projects.summary: Vertical movement joints resealed on a brick and panel elevation, with sealant applied from rope and backer rod fitted first. Individual joints can be reached at height rather than treating a whole elevation as a scaffold job.

heroImage.alt: A rope access technician applying sealant from a cordless gun into a vertical joint in brickwork
